purpose: A prespecified pooled residual-boosting experiment with a new store-group holdout. Previous v1 scores are known development evidence, not reused as independent test evidence.
development: Use exactly the previous ID-selected 500 series, publisher train split only. Historical v1 internal test becomes validation here; it is no longer claimed as independent test.

selection.exclude: Every city_id/store_id pair present in the 500 v1 development series; 355 stores excluded.
selection.stores: Sort remaining stores by SHA256('gerai-freshretailnet-v2:store:' + city_id + ':' + store_id), take first 200.
selection.product: Within each selected store, choose exactly one product with smallest SHA256('gerai-freshretailnet-v2:product:' + city_id + ':' + store_id + ':' + product_id). Selection never reads sales or scores.

target: Next two days' observed normalized sales; no latent demand recovery, ingredient conversion, imputation or synthetic fallback.
features: Last 14 observed sales divided by their mean (floor 1e-6), recent mean/median/std/trend/zeros, previous-week two-day pattern, log mean level, and last-seven-day stockout fraction. Calendar ablation adds weekday sin/cos and known upcoming weekend-day count. No future stockout, discount, weather or sales features.

fitting.sampleWeight: history_scale, so normalized residual loss targets absolute error in original normalized-sales units

validation: Use non-overlapping two-day origins starting at day 14. The last 14 days of each 90-day development series are validation; earlier origins train. Choose tree variant/size and residual weight by pooled validation MAE only. Weight zero explicitly permits retaining MA7.
finalFit: Refit chosen boosting configuration on every eligible origin in the development publisher train split through 2024-06-25. Parameters and residual weight remain fixed before reading any holdout target.
primaryTest: Publisher eval split for the 200 unseen stores: three complete non-overlapping two-day origins on 2024-06-26, 2024-06-28 and 2024-06-30, leaving the seventh day unscored. Earlier observed test days may enter later lags, no refit.
reporting: All 200 selected stores, including errors and poor scores; MAE/WAPE and stockout strata. Previous v1 metric values are not a direct apples-to-apples comparison because the test stores differ.
limitations: The held-out store records have not been scored in v1, but calendar conditions are shared with v1's known evaluation period. This is store-group transfer evidence, not a completely new temporal/domain replication or an Indonesian UMKM field test. Public models stay separate from user workspaces. No retuning after this test.
